annotations.grafana.app/sourcePath: AI Impact/AI Raw Volume & Delivery Outcomes.json

options.content:
**Scope & caveats:**

- **AI usage/activity figures on this dashboard come from Claude Code OTel** and are scoped through the connection-to-project mapping and the Project/Claude Code OTel Teams filters above. Activity totals use `canonical_activity` rows; model-usage totals come from `ai_model_usages`. Legacy Claude Admin-API and Cursor activity are excluded — neither carries a reliable per-project mapping, so mixing them in made the “Company-wide” figures uncomparable to the project-scoped delivery panels below.
- **Active Hours** is queried directly from Claude Code's OTel telemetry, not the shared `ai_activities` table — session duration isn't rolled up into the domain layer for any provider.
- **Commits/lines never merged are inflated by squash-merge workflows.** A squash-merged PR keeps only its final squashed commit in the ingested history — the original branch commits never show up as “merged” even though the code did ship. Read this row as an upper bound on abandoned work, not an exact measurement.
- **PR Abandonment Rate** is the delivery-outcome view of the same problem: no field links an AI session to the branch or PR it produced, so a dollar/token cost can't be attached to abandoned work directly. This table measures it a different way instead — PR-level: (PRs authored that closed without merging) ÷ (all PRs authored) — as an outcome-based proxy for wasted effort, not an AI-cost-denominated one.

spec.title: Commits Never Merged
spec.description: Commits with no record of ever landing in a merged pull request, scoped to the selected project(s). Inflated by squash-merge workflows — see the caveat above; read as an upper bound, not an exact count.

spec.rawSql:
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT c.sha) AS "Commits Never Merged"
FROM commits c
JOIN repo_commits rc ON rc.commit_sha = c.sha
JOIN project_mapping pm ON pm.row_id = rc.repo_id AND pm.`table` = 'repos'
LEFT JOIN pull_request_commits prc ON prc.commit_sha = c.sha
LEFT JOIN pull_requests pr ON pr.id = prc.pull_request_id AND pr.status = 'MERGED'
WHERE pm.project_name IN (SELECT upm_g.project_name FROM user_project_mapping upm_g WHERE upm_g.user_login = ${__user.login:sqlstring} AND upm_g.project_name IN ($project)) AND pr.id IS NULL AND $__timeFilter(c.committed_date)
  AND ('__all' IN ($developer_id) OR c.author_email IN ($developer_id))

spec.title: Lines Never Merged
spec.description: Additions + deletions summed over the same never-merged commit set above. Inflated by squash-merge workflows for the same reason — read as an upper bound, not a precise figure.

spec.rawSql:
SELECT SUM(sz) AS "Lines Never Merged" FROM (
  SELECT DISTINCT c.sha, (c.additions + c.deletions) AS sz
  FROM commits c
  JOIN repo_commits rc ON rc.commit_sha = c.sha
  JOIN project_mapping pm ON pm.row_id = rc.repo_id AND pm.`table` = 'repos'
  LEFT JOIN pull_request_commits prc ON prc.commit_sha = c.sha
  LEFT JOIN pull_requests pr ON pr.id = prc.pull_request_id AND pr.status = 'MERGED'
  WHERE pm.project_name IN (SELECT upm_g.project_name FROM user_project_mapping upm_g WHERE upm_g.user_login = ${__user.login:sqlstring} AND upm_g.project_name IN ($project)) AND pr.id IS NULL AND $__timeFilter(c.committed_date)
    AND ('__all' IN ($developer_id) OR c.author_email IN ($developer_id))
) x

spec.title: PR Abandonment Rate by Contributor
spec.description: PR-level, not commit/branch-level: (PRs authored that closed without merging) ÷ (all PRs authored), scoped to the selected project(s), minimum 5 PRs authored in range to avoid noisy small-sample rates. Measures delivery outcome, not AI-specific cost.

spec.rawSql:
SELECT COALESCE(NULLIF(a.full_name,''), pr.author_name) AS "Contributor",
  COUNT(*) AS "Total PRs",
  SUM(pr.status = 'CLOSED') AS "Abandoned (Closed, Never Merged)",
  ROUND(100.0 * SUM(pr.status = 'CLOSED') / COUNT(*), 1) AS "Abandonment Rate %"
FROM pull_requests pr
LEFT JOIN accounts a ON a.id = pr.author_id
JOIN project_mapping pm ON pm.row_id = pr.base_repo_id AND pm.`table` = 'repos'
WHERE pm.project_name IN (SELECT upm_g.project_name FROM user_project_mapping upm_g WHERE upm_g.user_login = ${__user.login:sqlstring} AND upm_g.project_name IN ($project)) AND pr.status IN ('CLOSED', 'MERGED') AND COALESCE(pr.merged_date, pr.closed_date) BETWEEN $__timeFrom() AND $__timeTo()
  AND ('__all' IN ($developer_id) OR a.email IN ($developer_id) OR a.id IN ($developer_id))
GROUP BY COALESCE(NULLIF(a.full_name,''), pr.author_name)
HAVING COUNT(*) >= 5
ORDER BY 4 DESC
LIMIT 25

spec.title: Tokens Burned
spec.description: Total AI tokens consumed, Claude Code OTel-only, scoped to the selected project(s)/team(s) (`SUM(ai_model_usages.*_tokens)`).

spec.rawSql:
SELECT SUM(input_tokens + output_tokens + cache_read_tokens + cache_creation_tokens) AS "Tokens Burned"
FROM ai_model_usages amu
WHERE ('__all' IN ($developer_id) OR amu.user_email IN ($developer_id))
AND source_connection_id IN (
  SELECT cp.connection_id 
  FROM _tool_claude_code_otel_connection_projects cp
  INNER JOIN _tool_claude_code_otel_connections c ON c.id = cp.connection_id
  WHERE cp.project_name IN (
    SELECT upm_g.project_name 
    FROM user_project_mapping upm_g 
    WHERE upm_g.user_login = ${__user.login:sqlstring} 
      AND upm_g.project_name IN ($project)
    ) 
    AND (c.team_slug REGEXP '^(${otel_teams:regex})$' 
    AND c.team_slug IN (
      SELECT c_g.team_slug 
      FROM _tool_claude_code_otel_connections c_g 
      JOIN _tool_claude_code_otel_connection_projects cp_g ON cp_g.connection_id = c_g.id 
      JOIN user_project_mapping upm_g ON upm_g.project_name = cp_g.project_name 
      WHERE upm_g.user_login = ${__user.login:sqlstring}
      )
    )
)
AND $__timeFilter(date)

spec.title: Claude Sessions
spec.description: Total Claude Code OTel sessions, scoped to the selected project(s)/team(s) (`SUM(ai_activities.num_sessions)`).

spec.rawSql:
SELECT SUM(num_sessions) AS "Sessions"
FROM ai_activities aa
WHERE record_kind = 'canonical_activity'
  AND ('__all' IN ($developer_id) OR aa.user_email IN ($developer_id))
  AND source_connection_id IN (
    SELECT cp.connection_id FROM _tool_claude_code_otel_connection_projects cp
    INNER JOIN _tool_claude_code_otel_connections c ON c.id = cp.connection_id
    WHERE cp.project_name IN (SELECT upm_g.project_name FROM user_project_mapping upm_g WHERE upm_g.user_login = ${__user.login:sqlstring} AND upm_g.project_name IN ($project)) AND (c.team_slug REGEXP '^(${otel_teams:regex})$' AND c.team_slug IN (SELECT c_g.team_slug FROM _tool_claude_code_otel_connections c_g JOIN _tool_claude_code_otel_connection_projects cp_g ON cp_g.connection_id = c_g.id JOIN user_project_mapping upm_g ON upm_g.project_name = cp_g.project_name WHERE upm_g.user_login = ${__user.login:sqlstring}))
  )
  AND $__timeFilter(date)

spec.title: Active Hours
spec.description: Total active engineering hours logged by Claude Code, from OTel telemetry, scoped to the selected project(s)/team(s). Not available at the domain layer for any provider.

spec.rawSql:
SELECT ROUND(SUM(ha.active_time_seconds) / 3600.0, 1) AS "Active Hours"
FROM _tool_claude_code_otel_hourly_activity ha
WHERE ('__all' IN ($developer_id) OR ha.user_email IN ($developer_id))
  AND ha.connection_id IN (
  SELECT cp.connection_id FROM _tool_claude_code_otel_connection_projects cp
  INNER JOIN _tool_claude_code_otel_connections c ON c.id = cp.connection_id
  WHERE cp.project_name IN (SELECT upm_g.project_name FROM user_project_mapping upm_g WHERE upm_g.user_login = ${__user.login:sqlstring} AND upm_g.project_name IN ($project)) AND (c.team_slug REGEXP '^(${otel_teams:regex})$' AND c.team_slug IN (SELECT c_g.team_slug FROM _tool_claude_code_otel_connections c_g JOIN _tool_claude_code_otel_connection_projects cp_g ON cp_g.connection_id = c_g.id JOIN user_project_mapping upm_g ON upm_g.project_name = cp_g.project_name WHERE upm_g.user_login = ${__user.login:sqlstring}))
)
AND $__timeFilter(ha.hour_start)

spec.title: AI Lines Added
spec.description: Total lines added by Claude Code OTel sessions, scoped to the selected project(s)/team(s) (`SUM(ai_activities.lines_added)`).

spec.rawSql:
SELECT SUM(lines_added) AS "Lines Added"
FROM ai_activities aa
WHERE record_kind = 'canonical_activity'
  AND ('__all' IN ($developer_id) OR aa.user_email IN ($developer_id))
  AND source_connection_id IN (
    SELECT cp.connection_id FROM _tool_claude_code_otel_connection_projects cp
    INNER JOIN _tool_claude_code_otel_connections c ON c.id = cp.connection_id
    WHERE cp.project_name IN (SELECT upm_g.project_name FROM user_project_mapping upm_g WHERE upm_g.user_login = ${__user.login:sqlstring} AND upm_g.project_name IN ($project)) AND (c.team_slug REGEXP '^(${otel_teams:regex})$' AND c.team_slug IN (SELECT c_g.team_slug FROM _tool_claude_code_otel_connections c_g JOIN _tool_claude_code_otel_connection_projects cp_g ON cp_g.connection_id = c_g.id JOIN user_project_mapping upm_g ON upm_g.project_name = cp_g.project_name WHERE upm_g.user_login = ${__user.login:sqlstring}))
  )
  AND $__timeFilter(date)

spec.title: AI Lines Removed
spec.description: Total lines removed by Claude Code OTel sessions, scoped to the selected project(s)/team(s) (`SUM(ai_activities.lines_removed)`).

spec.rawSql:
SELECT SUM(lines_removed) AS "Lines Removed"
FROM ai_activities aa
WHERE record_kind = 'canonical_activity'
  AND ('__all' IN ($developer_id) OR aa.user_email IN ($developer_id))
  AND source_connection_id IN (
    SELECT cp.connection_id FROM _tool_claude_code_otel_connection_projects cp
    INNER JOIN _tool_claude_code_otel_connections c ON c.id = cp.connection_id
    WHERE cp.project_name IN (SELECT upm_g.project_name FROM user_project_mapping upm_g WHERE upm_g.user_login = ${__user.login:sqlstring} AND upm_g.project_name IN ($project)) AND (c.team_slug REGEXP '^(${otel_teams:regex})$' AND c.team_slug IN (SELECT c_g.team_slug FROM _tool_claude_code_otel_connections c_g JOIN _tool_claude_code_otel_connection_projects cp_g ON cp_g.connection_id = c_g.id JOIN user_project_mapping upm_g ON upm_g.project_name = cp_g.project_name WHERE upm_g.user_login = ${__user.login:sqlstring}))
  )
  AND $__timeFilter(date)

spec.title: PRs Merged
spec.description: Merged pull requests, scoped to the selected project(s).

spec.rawSql:
SELECT COUNT(*) AS "PRs Merged"
FROM project_pr_metrics ppm 
JOIN pull_requests pr ON pr.id = ppm.id
JOIN accounts a ON a.id = pr.author_id 
WHERE ppm.project_name IN (SELECT upm_g.project_name FROM user_project_mapping upm_g WHERE upm_g.user_login = ${__user.login:sqlstring} AND upm_g.project_name IN ($project)) AND $__timeFilter(pr.merged_date)
  AND ('__all' IN ($developer_id) OR a.email IN ($developer_id) OR a.id IN ($developer_id))

spec.title: PRs Closed, Never Merged
spec.description: Pull requests closed without ever merging, scoped to the selected project(s).

spec.rawSql:
SELECT COUNT(*) AS "PRs Closed, Never Merged"
FROM pull_requests pr
JOIN project_mapping pm ON pm.row_id = pr.base_repo_id AND pm.`table` = 'repos'
LEFT JOIN accounts a ON a.id = pr.author_id 
WHERE pm.project_name IN (SELECT upm_g.project_name FROM user_project_mapping upm_g WHERE upm_g.user_login = ${__user.login:sqlstring} AND upm_g.project_name IN ($project)) AND pr.status = 'CLOSED' AND $__timeFilter(pr.closed_date)
  AND ('__all' IN ($developer_id) OR a.email IN ($developer_id) OR a.id IN ($developer_id))

spec.name: project
spec.label: Project

spec.__legacyStringValue:
SELECT DISTINCT p.name AS __text, p.name AS __value
FROM projects p
INNER JOIN _tool_claude_code_otel_connection_projects cp ON cp.project_name = p.name
INNER JOIN _tool_claude_code_otel_connections c ON c.id = cp.connection_id
INNER JOIN user_project_mapping upm ON upm.project_name = p.name
WHERE c.status = 'active'
  AND upm.user_login = ${__user.login:sqlstring}
ORDER BY p.name;

spec.definition:
SELECT DISTINCT p.name AS __text, p.name AS __value
FROM projects p
INNER JOIN _tool_claude_code_otel_connection_projects cp ON cp.project_name = p.name
INNER JOIN _tool_claude_code_otel_connections c ON c.id = cp.connection_id
INNER JOIN user_project_mapping upm ON upm.project_name = p.name
WHERE c.status = 'active'
  AND upm.user_login = ${__user.login:sqlstring}
ORDER BY p.name;

spec.name: otel_teams
spec.label: Claude Code OTel teams

spec.__legacyStringValue:
SELECT DISTINCT
    c.team_slug AS __text,
    c.team_slug AS __value
FROM _tool_claude_code_otel_connections AS c
INNER JOIN _tool_claude_code_otel_connection_projects AS cp
    ON cp.connection_id = c.id
WHERE c.status = 'active'
  AND (cp.project_name REGEXP '^(${project:regex})$' AND cp.project_name IN (SELECT upm_g.project_name FROM user_project_mapping upm_g WHERE upm_g.user_login = ${__user.login:sqlstring}))
ORDER BY c.team_slug;

spec.definition:
SELECT DISTINCT
    c.team_slug AS __text,
    c.team_slug AS __value
FROM _tool_claude_code_otel_connections AS c
INNER JOIN _tool_claude_code_otel_connection_projects AS cp
    ON cp.connection_id = c.id
WHERE c.status = 'active'
  AND (cp.project_name REGEXP '^(${project:regex})$' AND cp.project_name IN (SELECT upm_g.project_name FROM user_project_mapping upm_g WHERE upm_g.user_login = ${__user.login:sqlstring}))
ORDER BY c.team_slug;

spec.name: developer_id
spec.label: Developer

spec.query:
SELECT COALESCE(MAX(NULLIF(a.full_name, '')), MAX(NULLIF(a.user_name, '')), u.user_email) AS __text, u.user_email AS __value
FROM (
  SELECT amu.user_email, amu.account_id, amu.source_connection_id FROM ai_model_usages amu
  UNION
  SELECT aa.user_email, aa.account_id, aa.source_connection_id FROM ai_activities aa WHERE aa.record_kind = 'canonical_activity'
) u
LEFT JOIN accounts a ON a.id = NULLIF(u.account_id, '')
WHERE NULLIF(u.user_email, '') IS NOT NULL
  AND u.source_connection_id IN (
    SELECT cp.connection_id FROM _tool_claude_code_otel_connection_projects cp
    INNER JOIN _tool_claude_code_otel_connections c ON c.id = cp.connection_id
    WHERE c.status = 'active'
      AND cp.project_name IN (SELECT upm_g.project_name FROM user_project_mapping upm_g WHERE upm_g.user_login = ${__user.login:sqlstring} AND upm_g.project_name IN ($project))
      AND c.team_slug REGEXP '^(${otel_teams:regex})$'
  )
GROUP BY u.user_email
ORDER BY 1

      AND c.team_slug REGEXP '^(${otel_teams:regex})$'
